title: SplitRightClick
description: This mod split keybind for interacting with blocks and placing blocks similar to Hytale.
body:
**This mod has not been tested on server with anti-cheat and I am not resposible for any issue with anti-cheat**

This is a mod that split the key used for interacting with blocks and placing blocks since I am too lazy to fix my mussle memory after playing Hytale.

By default, the mod do nothing.

Two new keybind will be added to the Gameplay section. One for placing block and, one for interacting with blocks.
![Image of setting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e378f0991cd5675bfda40afe62ab35913afdbfa2.png)

The interact button is used to interact with a block, like opening a chest.

The place button is used for eating, interacting with item, and placing blocks.

This mod will crouch for you when placing on a block that is interactable, and uncrouch when interacting with a block. If you are flying, it will press space automatically to make you not fall down, note this also mean you could not change Y level while creative flying and holding place. 

## Limitation:

Interaction button with modded blocks will probably not work, use place button in case.

Changing redstone from dot to line use place as I am too lazy to check block nearby and it is not a big enough issue.
